assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent-background watercolor illustration for an empty-state UI panel. Reference image 1 is the APPROVED C concept board: use ONLY the small empty-state scene described below, do NOT reproduce any UI, text, logo, cards, frame or background from the board. Reference image 2 gives exact mascot identity and watercolor texture. Landscape vignette approximately 3:2 aspect ratio, centered scene fully in frame, softly feathered low oval meadow patch, pale sage grass, a few white and butter-yellow daisies, small olive leaves. Fine paper grain inside painted forms, delicate watercolor pigment, warm soft natural light. The character including head details fills about 70 percent of image height; meadow fills about 85 percent of image width. Genuine transparent empty space outside the painted scene, including all four corners, no white or ivory rectangle, no dark outline, no drop shadow. No words, lettering, symbols, UI or additional characters. All objects fully visible; modest transparent safe margins. Subject: the round pale yellow-green sprout mascot seen in the LEFT empty panel of reference 1 and reference 2. Two olive-green sprout leaves on top, tiny dark oval eyes, peach cheeks, small curved smile, small round arms and dark moss green feet. The mascot is resting cozily on its low meadow patch, looking down at a small OPEN cream book lying on the grass directly in front of it, arms resting by the book, relaxed and inviting. Keep character low, not upright in a standing pose. Reproduce the approved board's soft grounded empty-search illustration, not a floating sticker.
